Fed & Policy Watch

Today combines Treasury bill supply with Federal Reserve market plumbing: 13- and 26-week bill closings are verified at 11:00/11:30 AM ET, Commercial Paper at 1:00 PM, and H.10/G.5 plus H.15 at 4:15 PM. With SOFR at 3.85% and MOVE at 80.64, rates and funding confirmation matter more than a fresh FOMC headline.

NFCI remains -0.56, indicating looser-than-average broad conditions, while the 10Y is 5.01%. No NYSE holiday or shortened session is listed for September 21.

Omissions and Watch

BLS omitted: the official September 2026 schedule returned HTTP 403/access denied, so CPI, PPI, employment, and labor releases are not asserted. No Census, EIA, or BEA release is verified for Sep 21. Treasury 4- and 8-week bill records for Sep 24 are omitted because the refreshed records did not expose exact closing times. NAR is not required for the selected dates.

MOVE 80.64 is moderate uncertainty under the stated 80-120 band; NFCI -0.56 indicates looser-than-average conditions. All listed Treasury and Fed events have date/time support in the refreshed primary records.

Trading Strategy Note - ES Futures
Base Case

ES overnight 7745.50 is above the September 18 SPY close of 761.69. With bill closings at 11:00/11:30 AM and Commercial Paper at 1:00 PM, favor measured continuation only if funding remains orderly. SOFR 3.85%, MOVE 80.64, and 10Y 5.01% require smaller size around the Treasury supply window.

Invalidation

A decisive ES break outside the overnight range with 10Y above 5.01% or MOVE above 100 invalidates the continuation setup. Reassess after the 1:00 PM Commercial Paper release and 4:15 PM H.10/H.15 data rather than chasing the first reaction.
